digest.component_or_area: Gerrit review-bot authentication and webhook security
propositions: The GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN was leaked in plaintext via query-string logging before 66af was deployed to production
The token serves dual purposes as both Gerrit HTTP basic-auth credential and inbound webhook secret, requiring atomic rotation via service-user.sh to keep SSM and webhooks.config in sync
Code fix 66af (moving token to X-Rebar-Token header and adding TokenRedactingFilter) must be deployed to production before rotating the compromised token to prevent immediate re-exposure

Token rotation requires three coordinated infrastructure steps: updating the bot's Gerrit HTTP password, overwriting the SSM parameter, and pushing the new token to webhooks.config in refs/meta/config
